title: Actor-over-Worker Mailbox & Zero-Copy Reply
description: Trace how the main thread dispatches a command over MessageChannel while staying responsive for 60fps rendering.

steps.label: 1. Main Thread Posts Command + Port2
steps.description: UI dispatches a search/query intent with a dedicated MessageChannel port, immediately yielding back to rAF and input.

steps.label: 2. Worker Executes Sequentially
steps.description: Worker isolate drains mailbox#1, queries local OPFS index without locks, and packs result into a transferable buffer.
steps.codeHighlight: const buf = encodeRows(rows); replyPort.postMessage({ result: buf }, [buf]);

steps.label: 3. Zero-Copy Ownership Transfer
steps.description: Main thread receives the detached ArrayBuffer on port1 without structured-clone copy and commits minimal DOM updates.
